instructions: Slice each ciabatta roll in half horizontally, leaving one side attached.
Lay about 2 oz of mortadella on the bottom half of each roll, twisting and ruffling the slices so they sit loose instead of flat.
Close the rolls and serve right away.
method_notes: Christina's Cucina (the lead, 5.0 from 3, so a fallback lead) keeps it to crusty rolls and loosely folded mortadella, with cheese and pistachios as optional extras that I left out to keep it dairy-free and nut-free. Nonna Box adds pesto and artichokes, and Ricardo and Italian Food Forever press it hot with provolone or Asiago. Buy plain mortadella, since some deli versions have pistachios in them.
